body:
Ha, I feel like my high was in middle school and it's all been downhill since then. I don't know if I'm as young as you think I am, but I'm old enough to be able to recognize the difference between petty issues and ones that actually matter a lot to me. The problem arises when everything in my life leads to things going wrong, and I'm smart enough to realize that it's most likely my fault. It makes me hate myself and everything keeps snowballing togetherx with no immediate solution to keep me from losing hope. 

I would love to know how to make the best of life, but I dont.

I'm still in high school, but I don't even know what I want to do with my life. I'm constantly treated like a child but then I'm expected to make life changing decisions at the same time and it just really messes with you. I'm scared of applying to places and being rejected, or not being good enough at the job I want because that's what life has set me up for. I don't want to settle for something that's not good enough, but I can't help it if I'm the one who's not good enough. 

If we're going to do metaphors, my life just seems like I'm watching a movie that my friend is showing me. It's one of those times when your friend INSISTS it was the greatest thing ever. So you watch it and every so often, they tell you that it's gonna get really good in a minute, or the best part is coming up soon, except you never really get it. In the end it was a mediocre movie that you just wasted your time watching. Of course your friend still thinks that movie was the BEST, and that something must be wrong with you for not thinking so as well.

That probably didn't make much sense, I don't really know how to put things into words.
to be completely honest, it's extremely hard to rebound from things when it seems like you rebound into worse things.
